description.value: Steveston Coffee Company has been sourcing, roasting, and serving specialty coffee in the historic Steveston fishing village since 1997, making it one of the longer-running independent cafés on BC's lower mainland. The shop operates as a local roaster, retailer, and wholesaler, with an extensive menu of single-origin and house-blend beans alongside espresso drinks, teas, and largely homemade baked goods and sandwiches. It sits on Moncton Street in the heart of Steveston, a destination commonly reached by cyclists riding Richmond's dyke trail network.
